title: Random Source
text: Generate randomly distributed values, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Output sample period; {Distribution} sets the uniform, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Mean}, {Variance}, {Repeatability} sets the option to repeat block output, {Initial seed}, {Inherit via output port} sets the inherit output port parameters from downstream, {Samples per frame} sets the samples per output frame, {Signal complexity} sets the complexity of output, {Output data type} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal of randomly distributed values scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of uniform distribution 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of uniform distribution 1 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Mean
params.values: Mean value of Gaussian distribution 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Variance
params.values: Variance of Gaussian distribution 1 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Repeatability
params.values: Option to repeat block output Specify seed (default) | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed for random number generator 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Inherit via output port
params.values: Inherit output port parameters from downstream block off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Output sample period 1 (default) | −1 | real positive scalar

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Samples per output frame 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
